description: 林業及自然保育署山區手機可通訊點標示 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 本資料為標示林業及自然保育署山區手機可通訊參考點，通訊易受山區地形、氣候、電力供應等因素影響品質，請參考使用。 提供資料欄位包含：序號、名稱、分署(林業保育署地區分署名)、標示地(標示牌地點描述)、縣市、TWD97X(TWD97/121分帶坐標系統X坐標)、TWD97Y(TWD97/121分帶坐標系統Y坐標)、東經(WGS84坐標系統... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2026-06-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
